task.instruction: Show the scores and main highlight of the Milwaukee Bucks game that took place within the last 2 days on ESPN.

final_answer:
**Milwaukee Bucks 111 – Cleveland Cavaliers 136** (Final, Sat 1 Nov 2026, Fiserv Forum, Milwaukee)

**Quarter scoring:** CLE 24 | 48 | 37 | 27 — 136 · MIL 25 | 21 | 30 | 35 — 111

**Main highlight:** The Cavaliers blew the game open with a **48-point second quarter**, turning a 25-24 first-quarter deficit into a commanding 72-46 halftime lead. Evan Mobley led Cleveland with 27 points (11-16 FG) and Jarrett Allen added 25 (12-16 FG) plus 11 rebounds, with Donovan Mitchell scoring 15 and James Harden posting 13 points and 7 assists. Cleveland shot 62% in the first half while Milwaukee managed just 31%, and the Cavs led by as many as 34 late in the third quarter.

**Bucks side:** Kel'el Ware had 19 points and 10 rebounds off the bench, Tyler Herro scored 15, and Kyle Kuzma along with rookies Nate Ament and Brayden Burries each had 14. It was Milwaukee's second straight blowout loss (they fell 132-100 to Houston on Wednesday) and drops them to 1-5 on the season. The Bucks next visit Minnesota on Monday looking for their first road win.

judge.rationale: The ESPN recap page supports the final score (Cavaliers 136, Bucks 111) and the main highlight: Cleveland’s 48-point second quarter.
